postmaster.description: Local user (or address) that receives mail undeliverable to any fetched recipient.

daemon_interval.description: Polling interval in seconds when fetchmail runs as a background daemon. 0 disables daemon mode (run once and exit).

logfile.description: Absolute path for the fetchmail log file. Leave empty to write to syslog instead.

bounce_mail.description: When true, undeliverable messages are bounced back to the original sender. When false, they are silently dropped.

global_fetchlimit.description: Maximum total messages fetched across all accounts per daemon cycle. 0 means unlimited.

global_limit.description: Messages larger than this many bytes are skipped and left on the server. 0 means no size filter.

accounts.description: One entry per remote mailbox fetchmail should poll. Each entry configures the server, credentials, and how mail is delivered locally.

name.description: Human-readable label for this account; written as a comment only, not used by fetchmail.

server.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote mail server.

protocol.description: Retrieval protocol to use: imap, pop3, pop3s, imaps, apop, or kpop.

port.description: TCP port on the remote server. 0 lets fetchmail pick the protocol default (143 IMAP, 993 IMAPS, 110 POP3, 995 POP3S).

username.description: Login name on the remote mail server.

password.description: Password for authenticating to the remote server. Keep this file mode 0600.

local_user.description: Local system account that fetched mail is delivered to.

ssl.description: Wrap the connection in SSL/TLS. Required when using port 993 or 995.

sslcertck.description: Abort the connection if the server TLS certificate cannot be verified against the system CA store. Requires ssl: true.

folder.description: Remote mailbox or folder to fetch from. Leave empty to use the server default (usually INBOX).

fetchall.description: Download all messages including those already read on the server. Useful for initial migration.

keep.description: Leave messages on the remote server after fetching. Set to false to delete them once delivered.

mda.description: Shell command to pipe each message into for local delivery, e.g. /usr/bin/procmail -d %T. Leave empty to use SMTP delivery via smtphost.

smtphost.description: SMTP server to relay fetched mail through when mda is empty. Leave empty to use 127.0.0.1.

fetchlimit.description: Maximum messages to fetch from this account per poll cycle. 0 means unlimited.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response from the remote server before abandoning the connection. 0 uses the fetchmail built-in default.
